Incompetent vets. Misdiagnosed pet. My cat got a course of a strong steroid for allergies as opposed to being treated for flees. The vet omitted the basic flees test at the first visit. As a result, I spent £250 on 2 visits plus meds. My cat suffered for the last 2 weeks being treated with the steroid with multiple side effects including osteoporosis as his symptoms did not alleviate. AVOID

We came to this vet after the PDSA told us our guinea pig, Jelly, had misaligned teeth and an infection, and that he needed to be sedated for X-rays and dental treatment. Naturally, we were really worried. But when we brought him here, everything changed.

Jelly was seen by Elodie, who was kind, patient, and incredibly knowledgeable. She carefully examined him, checked all the relevant symptoms, and reassured us throughout. In the end, she determined that Jelly didn’t need sedation or the procedure at all!

We’re so grateful for her honest and thorough care. I can’t thank Elodie enough for turning such a stressful day into a relief.

I've been to numerous vets over the years & Medivet Stoke Newington has been by far the friendliest, gentlest, considerate vets I've used. I sadly had to put my cat down & was met with so much compassion & kindness by all staff members as well as a seamless service when it came to the cremation services. During such a heartbreaking time it's important to be met with a kind service & I'm thankful for the team at Medivet for all their help.
